## Report QA checklist (see docs/onboarding/05-writing-the-report.md)
- [ ] No remaining `[placeholders]` or `{instructions}`
- [ ] All numbers match the notebook JSON / executed notebook
- [ ] Country names and years correct in every caption
- [ ] Figures and tables numbered consecutively
- [ ] Peers match the previous report (or change explained)
- [ ] .docx and .pdf both included, named `<Country>_<year>`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/docx_to_md.py && python3 scripts/build_catalog.py` run
- [ ] No personal data or API keys added
